changelog: Initial release: Toggl time tracking via @beauraines/toggl-cli. Start/stop timers, view reports, manage entries.
summary: Track time with Toggl via the toggl CLI. Use when the user wants to start/stop time tracking, check current timer, view today's or weekly reports, list recent entries, or manage time entries. Triggers on "toggl", "time tracking", "timer", "track time", "what am I working on", "log time", "timesheet".
